Stainless Steel Hinges

Our solid Stainless Steel door hinges are available in brushed or polished finish in sizes from 3" x 3" to 4-1/2" x 4-1/2". Not only great looking, Stainless Steel hinges are great for exterior doors, bathrooms doors or any door where moisture and corrosion could be an issue.
